column2: Paper stop-motion animation: slow push-in on the paper mother as she taps her glowing paper phone, her folded paper face frowns in worry, the paper baby stirs slightly, subtle paper flutter, quiet night.

Paper stop-motion animation: slow dolly-in toward the paper marketing manager as she scrolls the picture-only paper web page, she sighs and rubs her temple, paper city lights twinkle behind the glass.
Paper stop-motion animation: macro slow dolly along the folded paper nutrition label as the purple light line sweeps across it, folded paper numbers and letters pop up and fly toward the camera.

Paper stop-motion animation: slow forward flythrough, folded paper cards stream from both sides and fold themselves into the bright floating paper website panel by panel, paper comets fly in and dock, light rays brighten.

Paper stop-motion animation: the paper mother reads her phone and her worried face turns into a relieved smile, she turns to her giggling paper baby and gently touches the baby's cheek, warm morning paper sunlight.

Paper stop-motion animation: slow push-in on the two paper brothers on the paper rooftop, they smile, then turn to look at the paper sunrise over the folded paper Seoul skyline, the younger brother puts a hand on his older brother's shoulder, paper hair flutters in the wind. Keep their faces consistent.
